verdict.rationale: Remote documents a single platform covering global payroll, EOR, and contractor management, including paying contractors with auto-pay. All employment types are created through one endpoint, which supports paying employees and contractors in one place. Nothing in the evidence addresses US W-2 payroll or 1099 contractor handling specifically. missing for 10: explicit US W-2 employee payroll support, 1099 contractor payment/tax-form handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can pay both W-2 employees and 1099 contractors from one platform

citations.quote: One platform for global payroll, EOR, and contractor management.
Onboard and pay contractors in 190+ countries ... Approve invoices with one click or auto-pay
All employment types are created through the same endpoint — `POST /v1/employments`
